name: Wavedash back punish
goal: Wavedash back out of a jump-in's range and grab it as it lands
why: A jump-in is aimed at where Fox stands. A wavedash back takes him out from under it in a few frames and leaves him facing it, free to act as it lands: the aerial's landing lag is the opening for a grab.

tutorial.what: When the opponent jumps at Fox: X or Y, then R with the stick back and a little down as he leaves the ground. As its aerial misses, dash in: X or Y and then Z, the jump-cancelled grab.
tutorial.expect: The opponent plays footsies, comes to its distance and jumps in: another opponent and aerial every try. A try begins when it starts its aerial and is judged when Fox grabs or hits it, when it hits Fox or his shield, or when it can act again.

marks.1: Frame 1: its {attack} starts. X or Y
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: R, the stick back and a little down: the wavedash back
marks.GO: Frame {GO}: its {attack} has missed. Dash in

lessons.title: Out from under it
text: {opp} jumps in with its {attack}, aimed at where Fox stands. A wavedash back is a jump and an air dodge into the ground on Fox's first frame in the air: he slides away, still facing {opp}.
The aerial comes down on empty ground.

marks.1: Frame 1: its {attack} starts. X or Y
marks.J+1: Frame {J+1}: R, the stick back and a little down: the wavedash back

cues.words: Out of its range: it misses

lessons.title: The landing
text: An aerial that lands has landing lag: {opp} cannot act until frame {FREE} of its {attack}.
Dash back in on frame {GO}, once its hitbox is past, and within reach press X or Y and then Z: the jump-cancelled grab comes out at once, sliding with the dash.

Within reach: X or Y, then Z

attempt.missed: Not counted: it did not jump in. Hold your ground: it comes to its distance and jumps.

out of range.expect: Out of its range as it lands
out of range.headline: Caught
out of range.fix: Wavedash back as it leaves the ground: X or Y, then R with the stick back and a little down on frame {J+1}, Fox's first in the air.

no shield.headline: Shielded
no shield.fix: Let it miss: the wavedash back takes Fox out of its range, and out of the shield there is less time left to punish.

wavedash.words: no wavedash: Fox did not slide back
wavedash.headline: No wavedash
wavedash.fix: X or Y, then R with the stick back and a little down on frame {J+1}, Fox's first in the air: the air dodge meets the ground and he slides.

punished.expect: A grab or a hit before it can act
punished.words: {opp} could act again before the punish
punished.headline: Too late
punished.fix: It can act on frame {FREE} of its {attack}. Dash in on frame {GO}; within reach, X or Y and then Z in the jump squat.

verdict.success: Punished {opp}'s {attack} on frame {at}; it could act on frame {FREE}.
